Acceptance_Rule: Historical identifiers and timestamps remain unchanged.
Departure timestamp is later than arrival timestamp.
Timestamp-derived duration reconciles with Actual_Stay_Hours within declared tolerance.
Vessel calls have deterministic ordering; same-time ties are explicitly flagged.
Negative inter-call elapsed time blocks that sequence link; never silently clipped.
Recovery cannot exceed either accumulated delay or the available elapsed-time opportunity G_k + x_k.
Every included call has one arrival and one departure event.
Port active-call state never becomes negative.
All included port calls depart by replay end.
Area under port concurrency equals sum of included observed call intervals.
Repeated baseline replay yields identical metrics.
Consecutive port calls are not described as verified physical sailing routes.
Port-call concurrency is not described as actual berth occupancy/capacity.
No actual transit is asserted without independent AIS/transit evidence.
Future metrics keep call-level delay and per-vessel accumulated/final delay separate.
Unrecovered and right-censored calls/vessels are reported separately.
